messages:
Priya Rao: quick async thread — prepping 30b model onboard. TL;DR: weights staged under s3://rw-inference-staging/zenith-30b/v1, tokenizer has an offset quirk, and RoPE scaling mismatch popped in the local canary. leaving notes + ask for quick owners.

Miguel Santos: I can take ownership of weights staging validation. will run checksum + small inference smoke. ETA few hours.

Jia Chen: noted the tokenizer quirk — seen this before when model export drops leading-space merges. short repro: input ' hello' tokenizes to [50256, 154] instead of [50256, 32, 154]. patch: try forcing `add_prefix_space=True` in our tokenizer loader.

Dan O'Neill: thanks Jia. i'll add a small unit to the tokenizer lint (tokenizer_lint.py) to assert prefix behavior. will also run the tokenizer on our standard promptset.

Priya Rao: Miguel — when you run the smoke, can you include a run with `--max-seq 2048` and a sliding-window tailing test? we saw a crash with sequence >2048 earlier. include a KV prefetch on/off compare.

Miguel Santos: yep. will do tests: `./smoke.sh --weights s3://... --max-seq 2048 --kv-prefetch on` and same with `--kv-prefetch off`. posting logs after run.

ops-bot: scheduled ephemeral job: smoke-zenith-30b-172345 (will expire in 6h).

Dan O'Neill: quick item on RoPE — the weights manifest indicates rope_scale=1.0 but our runtime applies legacy scaling for MQA models. need to confirm if this checkpoint expects scaled RoPE vs linear. failing mismatch -> attention impl produce shifted logits. MIGRATION-CHECK: diff params under `model_config.json` key `rope_scaling`.

Jia Chen: i inspected model_config.json in the s3 path — it has "rope_scaling": { "mode": "gqa", "alpha": 0.87 }. so it's GQA-style. runtime needs a small flag flip: `--rope-mode gqa --rope-alpha 0.87`. can we avoid hotfix by mapping in the weights router?

Priya Rao: we should avoid a code-hotfix for every model. Proposal: add a quick compatibility layer that reads `model_config.json` at load time and sets runtime settings accordingly. patch: small adapter in weights-router service. who can own a quick PR?

Miguel Santos: I can carve out a tiny PR to the weights-router to set rope/gqa flags from manifest. will include fallback to current behavior.

Dan O'Neill: i'll pair on the unit tests for attention to assert no logits shift after applying mapping. include a test with and without kv-prefetch to ensure no interaction regressions.

Priya Rao: cool. action items: Miguel — weights smoke + PR to weights-router; Jia — tokenizer lint and prefix fix; Dan — attention unit tests and sliding-window smoke; i'll coordinate canary scheduling and post results in this thread. please add short replies when tasks started/completed.

deploy-bot: canary queue updated: will run canary once all checks pass.

Miguel Santos: started smoke run now. logs will be up at https://internal-logs/runs/172345-smoke (posting selectively). :eyes:

Jia Chen: opened PR #4123 for tokenizer-lint and `add_prefix_space=True` default on loader. brief description and test vectors included.

Dan O'Neill: added attention unit that replays a short prompt with explicit RoPE params. local green. pushing test branch for CI.

Priya Rao: perfect — once Miguel confirms no checksum mismatch and the smoke passes with kv-prefetch on/off, i'll flip canary to staged. if any failing regressions, we hold. thanks team. :thumbsup:

Miguel Santos: smoke finished: checksum OK. two minor INFOs in logs about memory spikes at 1900 tokens with `--kv-prefetch on`. no crashes. attaching excerpt:

```
[smoke] loaded weights from s3://rw-inference-staging/zenith-30b/v1 OK
[smoke] tokenizer lint: prefix test FAILED (expected 3 tokens, got 2)
[smoke] attention check: logits shape OK
[smoke] mem: peak 42.1GB (1900 tokens) with kv-prefetch=on
```

Jia Chen: noted the tokenizer lint failure — PR updated to add an explicit migration step for exports missing `add_prefix_space`. pushing a small compat patch.

Dan O'Neill: passing attention unit tests locally, will kick CI. if CI green, i recommend we enable mapping in weights-router and run a full canary.

Priya Rao: sounds good. i'll wait for CI + Miguel's final canary pass. please @mention in this thread when ready.

Miguel Santos: will rerun smoke with Jia's compat patch once merged. expected in 30–60m.

Priya Rao: thanks — keeping this thread as the single-source updates. I'll follow up with a short checklist once canary completes.
